profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Years of developing analytics capabilities utilizing various social media platform APIs to extract valuable data, designing and implementing database structures and solutions, and developing complex aggregation queries and services. Leveraging cloud-based technologies with particular focus on AWS solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed large scale applications processing millions of requests per hour. Participated in bidding and optimizing for better revenues.
● Improved and decluttered codebase for better experiment strategy picking
● Integrated ad servers into system to expand bidding sources
● Built the Shoutout product, created interactive experiences for venues’ customers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing and enhancing VidMob's analytics features, providing clients with the necessary insights to make informed decisions about their video content strategy. Proficient in building APIs and architecting systems to support complex aggregation queries. Integrating third-party APIs to extract performance metrics from various social media platforms, and building pipelines and serverless systems to streamline data processing
• Built VidMob's analytics services from scratch in Scala.
• Iteratively developed data structures to support aggregation queries
• Integrated third-party APIs such as Meta, Google, Twitter, etc. to extract performance metrics into internal databases.
• Created ETL pipelines and serverless systems to streamline data processing which increased product performance and organization.
• Monitored user feedback, kept up with emerging trends and technologies, and collaborated closely with colleagues to enhance and refine analytics capabilities.
• Played a key role in keeping VidMob at the forefront of the industry.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leverage prototypes and documentation to design HTML web pages meeting customer expectations; implement JavaScript to improve functionality, and mange Thymeleaf integration. Handle exposure of internal web services to align with key functions. Liaise with team members in Japan to achieve project milestones.
•	Identified and resolved issues and discrepancies in product documentation.
•	Consistently completed ahead of schedule and beyond customer expectations.
•	Recognized for supporting team members in a deadline-driven environment.

Technologies: Java, JavaScript, HTML5, Spring Web, jQuery, JavaScript Libraries, Thymeleaf, Oracle, Spring Tool Suite, Spring, Hibernate.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to the development lifecycle for a wide range of projects; handled workflow development, controller development, library creation, web service creation, and architecture design. Managed unit testing to ensure software functionality. Coordinated software deployment.

•	Optimized work processes per customer request by designing key processes and projects.
•	Helped initializing a long-term relationship with client until now
•	Key member of the team recognized as Best Team of the unit for 2015

Technologies: Java, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, SQL, Spring Web MVC, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Eclipse, Oracle SQL Developer, Maven, Apache Tomcat, GIT, STS, Anypoint Studio, pgAdmin II, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Spring data, Spring JPA, RESTful, SOAP, Mule ESB

projects.title: Wireless Touchpad
projects.description: Designed a microchip capable of communicating with a touchpad, an RF module, and any mouse-supported OS via USB. Prepared project design documentation. Programmed communication between a MSP430 microchip and a mouse-supported OS. Developed and executed unit test cases.
